name: Steneck
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Steneck in Innsbruck**

Discover the cozy charm of **Steneck**, a traditional Tyrolean inn nestled in the heart of **Innsbruck**. Just a short stroll from the historic **Altstadt**, this family-run establishment invites you to experience authentic **Tiroler Gastfreundschaft** (Tyrolean hospitality) in a warm, rustic setting.

Indulge in hearty **Tiroler** specialties like **Kaiserschmarrn**, crispy **Speckknödel**, and perfectly grilled **Tiroler Gröstl**. Pair your meal with a frothy **Tiroler Bier** or a glass of local **Apfelwein** for the ultimate alpine dining experience.

After your meal, take a leisurely walk along the **Inn River** or explore the nearby **Nordkette** for breathtaking views of the **Alpen**. Whether you're here for a quick break or a longer stay, **Steneck** promises unforgettable moments in the heart of **Tirol**.
